what: minicore (`crates/test-utils/src/minicore.rs`, `pub mod iter`, the line `pub use self::adapters::{Filter, FilterMap, Take};`, about line 1990+65): add `Map`, giving `pub use self::adapters::{Filter, FilterMap, Map, Take};`. `adapters::Map` exists and `Iterator::map` returns `crate::iter::Map<Self, F>`, but `iter` never re-exports it. So in any fixture with `iterators`, `x.map(f)` has an unresolved return type and every method after it (`.collect()`, ...) resolves nothing. This is why blaze-lints `lints::more_clone_tests::format_collect` has failed every round since round 2: `v.into_iter().map(|b| format!(..)).collect()` gets no method resolution for `collect`, so the lint can't fire. Real core re-exports `core::iter::Map`. Other tests whose expected output shows `{unknown}` after a `.map(..)` may change with it; their new output is the right one.
